svg.aria-label: GET /healthz: Liveness. No dependency checks. GET /readyz: Readiness. 503 until the model is loaded. POST /v1/classifications: Classify an image (not stored). POST /v1/images: Store an image, return its id. POST /v1/labels: Admin. Needs SYNTHWERK_VISION_ADMIN_TOKEN. GET /v1/labels: Admin. Needs SYNTHWERK_VISION_ADMIN_TOKEN. DELETE /v1/labels/{id}: Admin. Needs SYNTHWERK_VISION_ADMIN_TOKEN. POST /v1/feedback: Admin. Needs SYNTHWERK_VISION_ADMIN_TOKEN
